title: Verify my client handles ACP session lifecycles
statement: As a developer building tools around AI harnesses, I can exercise ACP connection and session lifecycles through my own client against a real harness so that my library handles state transitions as well as message contents.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The consumer can perform protocol initialization and session creation against a supported real ACP agent integration, and the test can assert the resulting consumer state.
The consumer can start a prompt turn, consume its updates under controlled provider behavior, and observe its completion through the protocol rather than treating process exit as turn completion.
For a supported ACP integration, a test can keep a provider exchange pending, request cancellation through the consumer, and assert the resulting protocol and consumer state within a bounded wait.
